question.title: Newton-Raphson Root Finding with Convergence Guard
question.prompt: Implement a C/C++ function `double newtonRaphson(double x0, double tol, int maxIter)` to find the root of a non-linear equation f(x) = 0. Guard against division by zero (when |f'(x)| < 1e-9) and report non-convergence if max iterations exceeded.
question.solutionNotes: Formula: x_next = x - f(x)/f'(x). Check if fabs(f_prime(x)) < EPS to prevent division by zero. Iterate while fabs(x_next - x) > tol up to maxIter. Return NAN or print error if divergent.

sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_a: Lec. Nusrat Jahan: Emphasized relative error metric |(x_next - x)/x_next| < tol.
sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_b: Prof. Tariq Mahmud: Absolute error metric |f(x)| < tol or |x_next - x| < tol accepted.
sectionSpecificAllowances.sec_c: Dr. Kazi Tanvir Ahmed: Check for derivative singularity must return explicit code or status flag.

rubricCriteria.title: Derivative Singularity Guard
rubricCriteria.description: Checks if the derivative f'(x) is close to zero before performing division.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Explicitly verifies fabs(df) > 1e-9; halts or throws warning if zero derivative encountered (1.0 mark).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Mentions derivative check but tolerance is incorrectly 0.0 or placed after division (0.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: No singularity check; risks floating-point exception or division by zero (0.0 marks).

rubricCriteria.title: Iterative Step & Convergence Logic
rubricCriteria.description: Correct Newton-Raphson update step x = x - f(x)/f'(x) and stopping criteria.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Accurate iterative formula, properly compares step difference against tol, respects maxIter (2.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Correct formula but infinite loop risk or stopping criteria checked incorrectly (1.0 - 1.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: Wrong numerical formula used (e.g., Bisection or Secant instead of Newton-Raphson) (0.0 marks).

rubricCriteria.title: Convergence Status Reporting
rubricCriteria.description: Returns calculated root or handles non-convergence gracefully.
rubricCriteria.fullCredit: Returns root when converged; outputs clear warning/NAN when maxIter reached (1.5 marks).
rubricCriteria.partialCredit: Returns last value of x without indicating if convergence was attained (0.5 - 1.0 mark).
rubricCriteria.zeroCredit: Does not return root or crashes (0.0 marks).

penalties.title: Unchecked Zero Division
penalties.description: Divided by f'(x) directly without tolerance threshold check.

penalties.title: Infinite Loop / Missing Iteration Bound
penalties.description: While loop has no maxIter limit, causing program freeze if method oscillates.
